title: Midnight Sun CTF 2024 Quals
description:
Midnight Sun CTF is HackingForSoju's annual CTF event open to players around the world.

This qualifier event will allow 10 teams qualify for the on-site event in Stockholm Sweden in June.

https://discord.gg/xMuRxub4CX
prizes: Prizes include flights, hotels, swag etc. for the on-site finals as well as tickets to the conference and access to the after party.
